checks.description: Require the complete RTL bundle and reject additions, deletions, renames, read-only drift, or evaluator paths.
Validate the frozen wrapper parameters, ports, widths, directions, and required module names.
Elaborate and lint the frozen serv_synth_wrapper configuration.
Before mutation approval, compare the exposed immutable baseline and candidate with the task-neutral Yosys equiv_simple plus equiv_induct runner; fail closed on any unproven equivalence cell.
Run an independently written four-instruction RV32I program and require its exact word-store observation plus one exact pass sentinel.
Confirm generic synthesis completes and report diagnostic structural statistics without a PPA or improvement claim.

excluded_claims: The public software smoke covers one four-instruction path only; it does not establish hidden F2P/P2P, ISA compliance, timing, PPA, QoR, score, or benchmark PASS.
The public preapproval proof discharges one configured Yosys obligation only; it is not a frozen hidden oracle, complete formal equivalence, ISA compliance, F2P, or complete P2P.
No generic synthesis statistic is treated as area or an optimization result.
Hidden functional and PPA oracles are not exposed.
